title: The Master Mind Scholarship
field: Master's programmes (eligible list published by KU Leuven)
about: KU Leuven invites international applicants to apply for The Master Mind Scholarship for an eligible master's programme starting in 2027-2028. Candidates submit a complete programme application and register their scholarship candidacy online.
requirements: Complete application for an eligible KU Leuven master's programme
